material-family scaffold: all 34 EnergyPlus 26.1 public material base/overlay objects and their source-owned order are inventoried. The bounded typed implementation covers Material, Material:NoMass, Material:AirGap, Material:InfraredTransparent, WindowMaterial:Glazing:RefractionExtinctionMethod, WindowMaterial:Glazing:EquivalentLayer, WindowMaterial:Gas, WindowMaterial:Gap:EquivalentLayer, WindowMaterial:GasMixture, WindowMaterial:Shade, WindowMaterial:Shade:EquivalentLayer, and WindowMaterial:Drape:EquivalentLayer plus only the SpectralAverage branch of WindowMaterial:Glazing; unsupported optical modes explicitly fail closed. RefractionExtinction preserves its raw n/k inputs and EnergyPlus 26.1 formula/visible-back quirk. Equivalent-layer glazing preserves all 26 numeric inputs, six bounded Autocalculate states, source defaults, and the SpectralAverage-only contract without adding optical-sum validation absent from its source block; its ignored spectral-dataset string is type-checked but not retained. Ordinary Gas resolves Air, Argon, Krypton, and Xenon to exact built-in constants after type/schema checking supplied custom fields; Custom preserves the three A+B*T+C*T^2 coefficient sets, validates positive 300 K conductivity and source/schema bounds, derives nominal resistance, and intentionally retains numeric zero for a missing specific-heat ratio. Equivalent-layer Gap reuses those gas records with its schema-distinct uppercase gas enum and required Sealed, VentedIndoor, or VentedOutdoor mode, without inventing the schema note's unenforced Air-only relationship. GasMixture encodes a one-to-four active prefix of standard-only gases, validates the schema-required Gas 1/Gas 2 pairs even for count 1, preserves missing active optional Gas 3/4 fractions as zero, and allows duplicate species and non-unit sums without normalization; nominal resistance uses only the first gas at 300 K. MaterialFamily separates opaque, ordinary fenestration, and equivalent-layer consumers. Ordinary Construction rejects equivalent-layer glazing, gaps, shades, and drapes because only the still-deferred Construction:WindowEquivalentLayer may consume them, while the bounded ordinary-window subset accepts exactly Glass ((Gas\|GasMixture) Glass){0..3}.
